{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we have the final measurement per patient
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
num_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
total = len(control_moderate)
frac_responded = num_responded / total

# Print results
print(f"Number of control, moderate patients: {total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction who responded: {frac_responded}")

frac_responded"}
